lines.text: A blind, mute, demon-possessed man is healed, and the astounded crowds ask if Jesus is the Son of David.
The Pharisees say Jesus uses Beelzebul to drive out demons, and He says a divided kingdom will be laid waste.
Jesus says the Pharisees' sons will be their priests, and by God's Spirit the kingdom of God has come.
Jesus says a tree is known by its fruit, and men will answer for every careless word.
